title: Splash-able Concrete
description: Convert concrete powder to hardened concrete using water bottles and more!
body:
Use a splash or lingering water bottle to convert any colored concrete powder to their regular concrete counterpart. 

[![sponsor](https://legopitstop.weebly.com/files/theme/banner_9.webp)](https://bisecthosting.com/legopitstop)
Click on the above image, select plan (at least 4GB), use code `legopitstop` to get 25% off your first month and enjoy playing with your friends!

## Features

- Splash concrete powder with a splash or lingering water bottle to make it harden. 
- One bottle hardens a 3x2 area. 

## FAQ
### Can I add this to my mod pack?
Sure, as long as you give proper credit and follow the license.

### Are you going to downgrade to older versions (ie; 1.15, 1.12, 1.8)?
I will if there is enough demand for a certain version and I have time to.
